headline: Code Changes & Accelerated Review goes before Planning & Zoning Commission on Thursday, November 19
blurb: A light agenda for this one. The 222 West San Juan Avenue subdivision work session — which had been continued from October — has since been withdrawn by the applicant, so it won't be heard. The commission will get a presentation on wildfire modeling technologies from Firebird Chief Scientist Jason Sibold, and continue a work session on potential Land Use Code amendments to landscaping requirements (LUC 3-502) and tree maintenance and removal rules (LUC 3-505).
